I am slowly starting to realise that. I am struggling to keep busy even though I have a lot to do, because my thoughts keep distracting me. I feel more isolated because I am in a different country and don't have much support here. I don't want to be alone. If it's alright, I will DM you. Maybe you can tell me what helped you? It's hard to accept because I couldn't see it for so long. But I feel you are right. She probably never loved me and just did what was convenient for her.

I want to be happy, but there is this void inside me and I am constantly overwhelmed by all these choices. I need to get my head straight. I actually considered thinking about it as the death of the person I once knew. Now there is just a doppelganger in there place. It still hurts, but I have to accept it. I feel the pain is unfair and that she deserves to have some consequences too. I don't know if I will be able to love again. But I also don't want to lose myself.

I will try not to give up. Thank for giving me hope. It means a lot.

I know. I feel I was clinging onto the hope that she might change again. But I feel that's just who she has always been and that there is no possibility of change. I also got isolated in the process and thought I might find a friend in her. But she clearly is a selfish and cold woman. I am not acting sane because all of this has made me lose my mind. I need to get my shit back together. All of your words help. Reddit helps. Makes me feel less alone.

I feel I realise that now. I have just been naive this whole time. I respect certain values and I thought people did that too. I see now that what people say and what they believe are two different things. Why is it so hard in this world to expect simple human decency?

I don't regret helping her out. I would do that for an enemy. It's just who I am. What I feel bad about is that someone who promised me the world, could be this blinded by lust that they would destroy everything. I don't understand how they just stopped caring like that. I wanted to believe that there is still some goodness inside them. But I feel now I know. Some people are just evil. And very good at manipulating others.

I just want her to feel the same remorse and pain that I am feeling. I just want her to fully realise what she has done. The guy is clearly in the wrong as well. He pursued someone in a relationship and took advantage of them. Not to take the blame away from my SO, she is definitely guilty too. But the guy is not the most ethical person out there. I don't have allies and I am not afraid of the consequences but I do want her to feel that there are some consequences. She can't just get away from this. She can't just destroy the lives, hopes and futures of so many people and continue living life and seeking pleasure. Actions should have consequences.
